description: This file contains functions supporting the creation and handling of pack files, including pack header, object, trailer, and utility functions for printing data in specific formats. It includes routines for constructing pack data, handling compression, and referencing known objects, indicating its role as utility scripts for packfile manipulation within a version control system or similar application.

methods.name: uint32_octal
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte octal representation of a number.

methods.name: uint32_binary
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte binary representation of a number.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Generates a pack header for version 2 with specified number of objects.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Outputs pack data for an object, possibly as a delta against another object, handling well-known objects and full objects.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Computes and appends a pack trailer to a given pack data file.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Removes existing pack files to ensure subsequent packs are clean.
